🎨 UI SETTINGS
Make the hub truly yours.

- Adjust all sliders and keybinds to your preference.

---

This hub is for war. It's robust, straightforward, and puts you in control. Use it to survive, dominate, and—if you want—to make everything a bit more colorful.

⚔️ TAKE CONTROL. SURVIVE. DOMINATE.
